Shared mode: two candidates answer at the same time
Browser of the answering candidate (own working copy)
both candidates see the same PENDING
both working copies were loaded by app_snapshot at revision r;
the conditional UPDATE guards only its own working copy.
Across browsers the server decides: app_commit locks the
store row and accepts a change set only if its base
revision is still the current one (NFR-04, NFR-14).
[candidate 2 accepts at the same time (browser 2, revision r)]
same steps on this working copy:
current revision is r + 1, not r
Later: last remaining candidate answers can't (BR-13, FR-22)
("no co-worker can take it - contact the owner")
(if FAILED: a trigger allows REQUESTED -> FAILED)
(FAILED: the request is closed - no one could take it)
a single can't (DECLINED) notifies no one; only the
decline that makes every target DECLINED triggers
